_doc: Ảnh vẽ theo LƯỚI cho Science 5 — xem scripts/gen_grid.py. Lô này thay 6 ảnh tìm trên mạng (4/6 nền đen, chỏi hẳn với phong cách nền trắng của phần còn lại) và 3 ảnh cắt từ sách quét (hình giải phẫu nhiều chi tiết, ở 80px thành mảng hồng không nhận ra gì). Dùng 3×3 chứ không 5×5 vì chỉ có 9 từ: giá tính theo LƯỢT, gộp thêm ô trống không rẻ hơn mà ô lại nhỏ đi.
style: Style: simple clear flat illustration for a 10-year-old science book, bright friendly colours, bold simple shapes that stay readable when shrunk very small, plain white background in every cell.

words.circulatory system: a simple body outline with a red heart in the chest and red and blue tubes branching out through the whole body
words.blood vessels: a cut-away view of a blood vessel running across the picture, its round tube wall opened to show red blood cells flowing along inside
words.oxygen: a pair of pink lungs with bright blue arrows flowing in, and small blue dots being carried away into a red tube
words.pressure: a blood pressure cuff wrapped on an upper arm, its dial needle pointing high
words.windpipe: a head and chest from the side with one clear tube drawn from the mouth down to the two lungs
words.breathing: a child from the front with blue arrows going in through the nose and the lungs filling up
words.puberty: four young figures growing taller in a row from left to right, from child to teenager
words.vector: one mosquito on skin with a small red dot beside its bite
words.evidence: a glass of clear liquid fizzing hard with bubbles rising, a magnifying glass held beside it
